Todo.title: Todo Item
Todo.description: A todo list item containing text, completion state, priority, project, duration or alarm details, and owner UID.

text.description: The title or content of the todo item.

completed.description: Whether the todo is done or pending.

project.description: Name of the project or category the task belongs to.

time.description: Optional scheduled time for the task (e.g., '14:30').

reminderMinutes.description: Minutes before the scheduled time to trigger a notification.

userId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

todos/{todoId}.description: Individual todo tasks linked to a user
